description: This header file defines the HdmiInput class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, which inherits from AbstractPlugin. It declares methods related to HDMI input device management, EDID reading/writing, and event handling, indicating its role as a plugin component for HDMI input handling, communication, and notification within a media framework.

classes.name: HdmiInput
classes.description: A plugin class managing HDMI input devices, including initialization, event handling, and communication with HDMI hardware.

methods.name: getHDMIInputDevicesWrapper
methods.description: Handles retrieval of HDMI input devices, wrapping underlying implementation.

methods.name: writeEDIDWrapper
methods.description: Handles writing EDID data to a specified device.

methods.name: readEDIDWrapper
methods.description: Handles reading EDID data from a device.

methods.name: startHdmiInput
methods.description: Starts HDMI input on specified device or configuration.

methods.name: stopHdmiInput
methods.description: Stops HDMI input on specified device or configuration.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up and terminates plugin operations.
